title: ci(spec-shape-gate): register #24442's row-patch retirement against objectui#13022
body:
Fixes #24483

Clause-②: no

## What

One entry in `scripts/ci/spec-shape-retirements.json` for objectstack PR #24442 (merge commit `69f342b92470e0b66aa9b17ccd2fc7db04e4e568`), which retired a page action row's own `patch` with a `retiredKey()` tombstone. The downstream card is objectstack-ai/objectui#13022.

The pattern covers exactly one diagnostic. It is the TS2353 that Spec Shape Gate run `39206747055` (job `117911140691`) reported as NEW:

| field | value |
| --- | --- |
| `file` | `packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-button-undoable-11168.test.tsx` |
| `code` | `TS2353` |
| `message` | the full text the gate printed for it (`… 'status' does not exist in type …`, on the row-`patch` tombstone) |

The objectui line it covers is `:64`, `patch: { status: 'done' }`, on an `action:button` node with `operation: 'update'` (read at objectui `main` `47508f3bb`). That is the row `patch` #24442 retired. objectui#13022 covers the renderers and the Undo snapshot that still read the row `patch`, and this test pins that same Undo path.

## Evidence (local, at `04f90660e8`)

- `pnpm check:spec-shape-gate` (the reader's `--self-test`): `60/60 passed across 7 batteries`, exit 0.
- A probe that ran `parseRegistry` and `classifyRows` from the gate script over the committed registry gave these results:
  - The logged diagnostic reads `known`, entry `objectstack-ai/objectui#13022`.
  - A different code in the same file reads `unknown`.
  - The same TS2353 message in a different file (`action-icon.tsx`) reads `unknown`.
  - So the pattern is not wider than the one diagnostic.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 22 commands, and all 22 exited 0. The `--ran` reconciliation reads: `22 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 22 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero …)`.

## The registration's own gate run

This PR changes the registry, so the workflow's `pull_request` trigger runs Spec Shape Gate on it. That run is the proof the header asks for, and its verdict is reported in the `os-dev-report` comment on #24483. The card says `fb0d85b7fb` (#24458) also landed after run `39206747055`. The same report says whether this run shows any other NEW diagnostic. No entry is added for one: this PR registers only the #24442 diagnostic, against the card that covers it.

## Changeset

None. `scripts/ci/**` is not shipped by any package's `files[]`, and the root package is `private`. This PR publishes nothing, so it carries `skip-changeset`, route 2 of the Check Changeset gate.
